title: Typed Explorer paths
whyItMatters: This key holds paths typed into Explorer's address bar, revealing locations the user navigated to directly.
notes: Only value and subkey counts are reported; the typed URLs and paths themselves are never read.

steps: Only if you are not doing the full reset at the end of this plan, and you are comfortable with Registry Editor:
Open Registry Editor and go to the key named in the plan.
Delete the values in that key but keep the key itself; this empties the list.
cleanup.risk: Removes the addresses typed into the Explorer address bar for this account. Windows starts a new list when addresses are typed again.
